title: Reaching the Next Generation with Faith and Finance
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he shares a powerful message about the importance of reaching the next generation with the love and message of Jesus, as The River Church of Kansas City prepares for a massive VBS event that will bring hope and salvation to over 200 kids in their community. Hear how Pastor Zehner's passion for souls and his trust in God's provision are inspiring his congregation to make a difference in the lives of young people. Don't miss this inspiring and timely message that will challenge and encourage you to get involved in reaching the next generation with the gospel.
